           ZINCUM VALERIANICUM

         Valerinate of Zinc

        (ZINCUM VALERIANUM)


A remedy for   neuralgia  , hysteria,
        angina pectoris, and other   painful   affections, notably
        in   ovarian affections  . Epilepsy without aura. Hysterical
        heart-pain.   Facial   neuralgia, violent in left temple and
        inferior maxillary. Sleeplessness in children. Obstinate   hiccough  .



Head.--  Violent, neuralgic,   intermittent
        headaches  . Becomes almost insane with pain, which is piercing and stabbing.
        Uncontrollable sleeplessness from pain in head with melancholy.



Female.--    Ovaralgia; pain shoots down
        limbs  , even too foot.



Extremities.--  Severe pain in neck and spine. Cannot sit still;
        must keep legs in constant motion. Sciatic neuralgia.



Dose.--  First and second trituration. Must be continued for
        some time in treatment of neuralgia.
